game_concept: A speed quiz set in Shadow Cave – Stalactite Hall, a hall of dripping stalactites: the lantern keeper must handle slime blobs while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Stamina Climb: Keep climbing while stamina > 0, deciding when to rest inside the loop.
theme: Shadow Cave – Stalactite Hall: a hall of dripping stalactites
core_gameplay_loop: In Stalactite Hall, repeat each round: Keep climbing while stamina > 0, deciding when to rest inside the loop. Each round, a new glowing mushrooms challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the stamina value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 210 points of glowing mushrooms by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 210, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 6 (applied tier): Stamina Climb
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Stamina Climb' (Week 4 slot 3), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Stalactite Hall'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stamina changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against slime blobs in Stalactite Hall.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 210 within 63 seconds.
